title: admin account sign-in from unknown IP 03:12
description: alert from identity monitoring: admin-rk (domain admin) signed in at 03:12 from 185.220.x.x, not one of our ranges, then created a new account 'svc-backup2' and added it to Domain Admins. rk is on leave and says it wasnt him
label_note: A compromised privileged account is an identity security incident, so it is access and urgent.

title: wrong phone number in directory
description: The directory still shows my old desk extension, 4412. My new one has been 4587 since I moved floors. People keep calling the wrong desk.
label_note: A directory record update is access and low.

title: sso asks me to sign in every hour
description: since last week the single sign on page asks me to log in again every hour or so in every app. i can log in fine, its just annoying
label_note: An SSO session lifetime issue is access, and it is medium because it is an annoyance.

title: phone stolen in Tokyo - can't do MFA
description: My work phone was stolen in Tokyo last night. My laptop is fine, but every sign-in wants an approval on the phone. I'm here for meetings all week and can't get into email or the CRM. Can my MFA be reset and the phone's access cut off?
label_note: Resetting MFA and revoking a lost device's sessions is access, and it is high because the user is blocked.

title: inspector needs access tomorrow
description: The regulator's inspector is visiting tomorrow and has asked for read-only access to our incident reporting system for the day. We only found out an hour ago. Can a temporary account be ready by 9am?
label_note: A temporary account request is access; priority is debatable because requests are usually low, but a regulator visit tomorrow could justify high, so it is labelled medium.

title: admin password posted in company chat
description: Someone on the infra team pasted the shared firewall admin password into the company-wide 'general' chat channel by mistake about 20 minutes ago. It's been deleted, but around 900 people are in that channel and some will have seen the notification.
label_note: An exposed privileged credential needs immediate rotation, so it is access and urgent as a security incident.

title: locum doctor starting today has no login
description: Dr Okafor is a locum covering the medical admissions unit from today until Friday. He has no login for the patient record system or e-prescribing, and the agency says the request went in last week. He's seeing patients now and borrowing a nurse to look things up.
label_note: Missing accounts for a new clinician are access, and it is high because he is blocked in a clinical role.

title: register a security key as backup MFA
description: I'd like to register a hardware security key as a backup sign-in method in case my phone is ever lost. I've bought the one on the approved list.
label_note: Adding an MFA method is access and low.

title: need admin rigths to install dev tools
description: new to the data team, i need local admin rigths on my laptop or someone to install python, a db client and a few libraries. manager approved. until then im doing everything on the shared analytics server which is slow
label_note: A local admin rights request is access, and it is medium because there is a slow workaround.

title: password reset site down + everyone expired
description: monday morning and the password reset site shows 'Service unavailable'. loads of people in tokyo and chennai had passwords expire over the weekend and cant set new ones, helpline queue is 45 mins
label_note: A down password reset service with mass expiries is identity, so it is access, and it is urgent because many users are blocked.

title: password not working - keyboard broken?
description: My password keeps getting rejected on the login screen and now it says the account is locked. I'm sure I'm typing it right, so maybe the keyboard is broken? Everything seems to type fine in the username box.
label_note: A lockout after failed attempts needs an unlock and reset, so it is access, and it is high because the user is blocked; the user's keyboard guess points to hardware.

title: wiki says no account found
description: since my username changed from rkumar to ravi.kumar the team wiki says no account found when i sign in. everything else works with the new name. i can read pages logged out but cant edit
label_note: An account not mapped after a username change is access, and it is medium because reading still works.

title: account for summer intern in June
description: We have a summer intern joining finance on 2 June for 10 weeks. Could an account be set up with email and read-only ERP access, expiring on 8 August?
label_note: Planned new-joiner setup is access and low.

title: promoted to payroll lead - can't open payroll folder
description: I was promoted to payroll lead on Monday and need the payroll restricted folder to prepare this month's run, which closes Friday. At the moment I get 'Access denied'. HR's approval is attached.
label_note: A permission change for a new role is access, and it is high because a payroll deadline depends on it.

title: access problem
description: having access problem again, same as before
label_note: The ticket is vague, refers to an unknown earlier ticket and names no system, so it is labelled access by its wording, with medium as a placeholder until details are known.

title: Tokyo PCs: trust relationship failed
description: Since about 8:30 nobody in the Tokyo office can log into their desktops. It says 'The trust relationship between this workstation and the primary domain failed.' Laptops that were already logged in still work. About 50 people can't start work.
label_note: A domain trust failure is a directory and identity issue, so it is labelled access and urgent because many users are blocked; it could be routed to network because losing connectivity to domain controllers can cause it.

title: my approvals going to my old manager
description: My profile still shows me in logistics, though I moved to procurement last month. Because of that, my leave and expense approvals keep going to my old manager, who has to forward them on.
label_note: A stale directory attribute driving approvals is access, and it is medium because there is a manual workaround.

title: auditor login says user does not exist
description: set up yesterday for the external auditor: login AUD-TEMP-03. this morning she gets 'user does not exist' on the finance system. fieldwork started at 9 and shes sitting in our meeting room waiting
label_note: An account not provisioned correctly is access, and it is high because a time-critical audit is blocked.

title: annual review of team folder permissions
description: As part of the annual access review, could I get a list of everyone with access to the Sales Contracts folder? I'll mark who should be removed and send it back.
label_note: An access review request is access and low.

title: need write access to the reporting repo
description: i only have read on the reporting-pipelines repo, need write to push my branch for the new dashboard. tech lead approved in the pr comments
label_note: A repository permission request is access, and it is medium because work is delayed but not stopped.

title: patients can't log in to the portal
description: Since 00:00 every patient trying to sign in to the online portal gets 'Login failed: identity provider certificate expired (IdP cert valid until 2026-11-03T23:59:59Z)'. Support has had 200+ calls this morning, and patients can't see appointments or results.
label_note: An expired identity provider certificate breaks sign-in, so it is access, and it is urgent because it is a customer-facing outage.

title: cloud storage says my device isn't compliant
description: When I open the company cloud storage on my laptop I get 'Access blocked: your device doesn't meet your organisation's compliance requirements.' I can't reach any of our project files. Nothing has changed on my laptop that I know of.
label_note: A conditional access block is labelled access and high because the user is blocked; the underlying cause could be a missing update or encryption setting on the laptop, so it could be routed to software.

title: password expiry emails every hour
description: getting 'your password expires in 14 days' every hour since yesterday, 20 so far. i know, ill change it, but can it stop
label_note: A misfiring password expiry notification is access, and it is medium because it is an annoyance.

title: update job title in directory
description: My job title in the directory still says Analyst. I was promoted to Senior Analyst in October. Could it be updated?
label_note: A directory attribute update is access and low.

title: claims queue says no permission after migration
description: Since the claims system moved to the new platform on Saturday, I get 'You do not have permission to view this page' when I open the high-value claims queue. I've worked that queue for three years and others in my team can still open it.
label_note: A role not migrated is access, and it is high because the user can't do their main work.

title: invoice approval system is down
description: The invoice approval system is down, I get an error whenever I open the approval screen. Can you get it back up? I have 15 invoices waiting. My colleague says it's working for her, so maybe it's only partly down.
label_note: It works for a colleague, which points to the user's role or permission rather than an outage, so it is access, and it is medium because invoices can wait briefly; the user believes it is a system fault (software).

title: entered my password on a fake page?
description: I clicked a link in an email about a shared invoice and it took me to a login page that looked like ours. I entered my username and password, then it went blank. Now I've noticed the address was odd. I'm in accounts payable and I can change supplier bank details.
label_note: Compromised credentials need an immediate reset and session revoke, so it is access and urgent because of privileged finance access; it could be routed to email as a phishing report.

title: set up my PA as delegate in expenses
description: Could my PA, Lakshmi, be set up as a delegate in the expenses system so she can submit claims for me? I have three months of claims outstanding and finance keeps chasing me.
label_note: A delegation permission is access, and it is medium because there is some business pressure but no block.

title: guest access for external consultant
description: An external consultant is joining our process improvement project next Monday for 6 weeks. Could she get guest access to the project's collaboration space? Her email is consultant@partnerfirm.example.
label_note: A planned guest access request is access and low.

title: back from leave, password expired, clinic at 10
description: back from 3 weeks leave, password expired while i was away and the change password screen says my old password is wrong. sure it isnt. clinic starts at 10
label_note: An expired password that can't be changed is access, and it is high because a clinician is blocked before clinic.

title: forgot the startup PIN for my laptop
description: My laptop shows a blue screen asking for the drive encryption PIN before it even boots, and I've forgotten it after a month away. Now it's asking for a recovery key. My work is all on the share, so I'm on a hot desk PC for now.
label_note: Retrieving an encryption recovery key is a credential task, so it is labelled access, and it is medium because there is a workaround; it could be routed to hardware or software because it involves device encryption.

title: everyone can see salaries in HR system
description: Since this morning's HR system change, ordinary staff can see everyone's salary and bank details on the 'Team' tab. At least three people from different departments have messaged me about it. I'm in HR.
label_note: A permissions error exposing sensitive data to all staff is access, and it is urgent as a security incident.

title: can't log in to the IT portal to raise this
description: ok so this is a bit ironic. i wanted to raise a ticket about my headset (its fine now, it was the mute button, sorry) but the IT self-service portal says my account isnt licensed for it. a colleague is raising this for me. id like to be able to log in myself next time
label_note: A missing application entitlement is access, and it is medium because there is a workaround.

title: need production DB write access to fix live issue
description: Order confirmations aren't being sent to customers. I've found the cause, but the fix needs a data update on the production database and I only have read access. The on-call DBA isn't answering. Can I get temporary write access for the next two hours?
label_note: A break-glass access request is access; priority is debatable because the requester isn't blocked from normal work (high), but it is the route to fixing a customer-facing incident, which could justify urgent.

title: access to the Tokyo payroll system
description: I've been made HR liaison for the Tokyo office and need read access to their payroll system to answer staff queries. The Tokyo HR manager has approved it by email.
label_note: An application access request for a new responsibility is access and medium.

title: add new member to approval group from 1st
description: Please add Farhan to the 'Purchase Approvers - Facilities' group from 1 December, when he becomes facilities manager.
label_note: A planned group membership change is access and low.

title: can't log in to my PC and monitor flickering
description: Two problems. My PC login says 'The user name or password is incorrect' even though I changed it yesterday and it worked then. And my second monitor flickers now and then. I can't do anything until I can log in.
label_note: This ticket has two problems, and the primary one is the login failure (access), which blocks all work, so it is high; the flicker is a secondary hardware issue.

title: can't approve leave for my new report
description: Akira joined my team in Tokyo two weeks ago, but his leave requests still go to his old manager. When I open the approvals screen, he isn't listed under my team.
label_note: A reporting-line mapping in the identity system is access, and it is medium because the old manager can still approve.

title: nobody can approve purchase orders
description: Since last night's procurement system role clean-up, neither of our two plant managers has the approval role. Purchase orders are stuck, including spare parts for a broken packing machine on line 3. The line is running at half speed on the other machine.
label_note: Removed approval roles are access; priority is debatable because only two users are affected (high), but production is impacted, which justifies urgent.

title: bi workspace access
description: need read access to the Finance BI workspace, my weekly cost report pulls from there and now its asking me to request access. can use last weeks export for now
label_note: A workspace permission is access, and it is medium because there is a workaround.

title: take me off old project folders
description: can you remove me from the old 2022 project folders, i get notifications from them all the time and dont need them
label_note: An access removal request is access and low.

title: locked out of patient records mid-shift
description: I'm the registrar on nights in A&E and I've been locked out of the patient record system after my session timed out. The reset needs my phone, which is in my locker on another floor, and I have a patient in front of me.
label_note: An account lockout is access, and it is high because a clinician is blocked mid-shift.

title: locked out of learnig portal
description: locked out of the learnig portal, my mandatory fire safety training is overdue on friday and my manager keeps reminding me. reset link says my account doesnt exist?
label_note: An application account problem is access, and it is medium because there are a few days before the deadline.

title: cctv viewer says no permission
description: im the new security supervisor, the cctv viewing software opens but says i dont have permission to view any cameras. the old supervisors role was never moved to me. using the guard desk pc for now
label_note: A role not reassigned is access, and it is medium because there is a workaround.

title: read access to policy archive
description: Could I get read access to the policy archive on the compliance site? I'm updating our procedures and want to compare older versions.
label_note: A non-urgent access request is access and low.

title: vendor master data access for clean-up project
description: I'm leading the vendor data clean-up project starting next Monday and need edit access to the vendor master data screens in the ERP. The project sponsor has approved.
label_note: An application role request with a near start date is access and medium.

title: account locks every few minutes - my script?
description: My account keeps locking every few minutes. I think it's the scheduled reporting script on the analytics server, which still has my old password saved, because I changed my password this morning. Each time I unlock it, it's locked again within 5 minutes and I can't work.
label_note: The lockout loop needs the account unlocked and the stale stored credential fixed, so it is labelled access, and it is high because the user is blocked; it could be routed to software because a script holds the old password.

title: shift swap app shows old ward
description: moved from ward 4 to ward 11 last week. the shift swap app still only shows ward 4 shifts, cant see or swap any ward 11 ones. ward manager says shes approved my move
label_note: A role or group not updated after a move is access, and it is medium because the user isn't blocked from core work.

title: keep old team folder until handover ends
description: I'm moving to the Pune office next month but will hand over my Chennai accounts until the end of December. Could I keep access to the Chennai team folder until 31 December and then have it removed?
label_note: A planned access change is access and low.

title: logged in as someone else??
description: weird, when i log in to the timesheet system it shows another persons name and timesheets, not mine. same surname, different first name. i havent touched anything
label_note: An identity mapping error links the user to the wrong account, so it is access; priority is debatable because nobody is blocked (medium), but it exposes another person's data and could be raised to high.
